operational_capabilities.technical_features: Dedicated 50Hz-to-60Hz frequency conversion substation ensuring clean green grid electricity to international vessel standards.

shore_power_ops.environmental_regulations: Under current maritime regulations, cruise vessels calling at Marseille that fail to connect to OPS must operate on LNG or clean equivalent fuels while at berth, or face stringent idle-emission financial penalties.
shore_power_ops.source: Marseille Fos Port Authority CENAQ Program Report & MedCruise Association 2026
